title: Unpalatable
summary: UNPAL'ATABLE, adjective 1. Not palatable; disgusting to the taste. 2. Not such as to be relished; disagreeable; as an unpalatable law.

inlines.v: UNPAL'ATABLE, adjective 1. Not palatable; disgusting to the taste. 2. Not such as to be relished; disagreeable; as an unpalatable law.
